# p0_tableau_ai_staged (Resource)

A staged Tableau site installation for agentic access. Staging generates the identifiers needed to deploy P0's Tableau connector.

Use the read-only `secret_manager` connector attributes to deploy the connector's Cloud Run service and its admin connected app's secret. Once the connector is deployed, create a `p0_tableau_ai` resource with the same `id` to complete the installation.

**Prerequisite:** P0 must be installed on the Google Cloud organization (for example via the `p0_gcp` resource).

**Note:** This integration is currently in beta.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires the p0_gcp integration to already be installed for the same
# organization.

resource "p0_gcp" "example" {
  organization_id = "123456789012"
}

resource "p0_tableau_ai_staged" "example" {
  id          = "my-tableau-site"
  server      = "https://us-east-1.online.tableau.com"
  content_url = "acme"

  secret_manager = {
    type       = "gcp-sm"
    project_id = "my-project-id"
  }

  depends_on = [p0_gcp.example]
}

# See the p0_tableau_ai example for the next steps (deploying the connector
# and its admin connected app's secret) that complete the install.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content_url` (String) The site name (its content URL), as shown after `/site/` in its address (e.g. `acme` in `https://us-east-1.online.tableau.com/#/site/acme/home`).
- `id` (String) An identifier for the Tableau site, made of letters, digits and hyphens. P0 puts it in the name of every secret that it makes.
- `secret_manager` (Attributes) Where P0's Tableau connector runs and stores the admin connected app's secret (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--secret_manager))
- `server` (String) The site's Tableau Cloud pod URL, as shown before `/#/` in its address, without a trailing `/` (e.g. `https://us-east-1.online.tableau.com`).

### Read-Only

- `state` (String) This item's install progress in the P0 application:
	- 'stage': The item has been staged for installation
	- 'configure': The item is available to be added to P0, and may be configured
	- 'installed': The item is fully installed

<a id="nestedatt--secret_manager"></a>
### Nested Schema for `secret_manager`

Required:

- `project_id` (String) The GCP project that hosts the connector's Cloud Run service and the secret that holds the admin connected app.
- `type` (String) The secret manager that stores the admin connected app. Only `gcp-sm` (Google Secret Manager) is supported.

Read-Only:

- `connector_region` (String) The GCP region in which to deploy the connector's Cloud Run service
- `connector_service_account` (String) The email of the GCP service account that the connector must run as
- `connector_service_name` (String) The name to give the connector's Cloud Run service
